title: Compose nineteen temporal gauges with exact fixed-menu optimality
body:
The nineteen pinned zero-static temporal schedules from PR1369 can be composed on PR1263's static background for **134070/134086 complex primitives**. This saves **1132 primitives per orientation over the reproduced PR1388 pair**, or 1932 over the static word, with every inserted SCALE charged.

The contribution supplies a portable verifier and an exact proof that the full menu is the unique optimum among its 524288 subsets. ADD interactions are pairwise; every schedule has a strictly negative worst-case addition marginal. It is a fixed-menu result, not a global temporal-path optimum.

Local validation passed on Python 3.12.15: registered replay, all 712 scalar columns in both orientations, exact static/pair invoices, sixteen direct subset invoices covering both nonzero interaction pairs, omitted-SCALE rejection, read-only relocation, input-integrity and optimized-Python rejection. Original bounded validation also enumerated all subsets by two exact methods. Vendored code and source credits are retained with immutable Git/SHA pins.

**Scope:** The recursive profile is unchanged and this gives no new κ. The current generic adapter allowance increases because of the additional macros; no smaller complete native or hosted invoice is claimed. NATIVE-BOUNDARY.md records the actual source formula and retained receipt. This is a finite scalar contribution, not a replacement selected frontier.

Related work: #1369, #1388, #1263, #1259, #1161. The original overlap scan covered 866 open PRs, 123 discussion records and 325 local notes. A fresh October 14 title/body search for both exact totals and the all-nineteen/fixed-menu composition found no matching PR; PR1369 leaves independent minima uncomposed and PR1388 composes only its two-helper pair. This scoped search is not a novelty certificate or a complete code/discussion survey. Nonzero-static schedules discussed in #1376/#1385/#1398 and Discussion1163 are excluded.

Prepared for George Lydakis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including Ody's read-only integration review. No independent human review is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-temporal-menu-composition
```

Publication head: [`9ff4226c`](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/commit/9ff4226c2e80b9ed45213c3ab2575ad5cf47bc94). All 22 public file blobs match the reviewed local commit. Fork push workflows started on this exact head. At publication, the six upstream pull-request workflows, including [registered research packages](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38593494345), report `action_required` pending maintainer approval. This is not a hosted CI pass; the completed local validation is documented above. Known failures on the separate synced fork-main commit are not attributed to this contribution.
